semiconductor_relevance: High — SilcoTek provides specialized coatings that enhance the performance and longevity of semiconductor components.
summary: SilcoTek develops and supplies patented corrosion-resistant coatings that improve the durability and chemical compatibility of semiconductor components. Their silicon amorphous coating serves as an environmentally friendly alternative to PFAS, enhancing corrosion resistance and providing excellent release properties.
capabilities: Silicon amorphous coatings as alternatives to PFAS
